# Manager Self-Service Rollout

Getting Pellmore's line managers to approve absence and raise changes themselves in Talvento, instead of emailing People Services or filling in Staffora paper forms. I run the training bookings and the tracker, and I deliver about half the sessions at Head Office.

## Outcome

All 410 line managers trained and approving absence and changes in Talvento (288 trained as of 2026-10-16).

## Current State

- 288 of 410 trained (70%) as of 2026-10-16 ([[manager-self-service-training-tracker]]).
- By division: Head Office 61 of 64, Forwarding 33 of 38, Road Freight 92 of 131, Warehousing 102 of 177.
- Warehousing is behind because peak hiring took team leaders off the floor sessions. Sessions at the hubs restart after peak, from 2026-11-30.
- In September, 81% of absence requests from trained managers' teams were approved in Talvento within two working days; 7% were still approved after the payroll cut-off ([[can-managers-approve-absence-after-the-cut-off]]).

## Scope and Boundaries

Line managers with at least one direct report: absence approval, sickness recording, change of hours, change of manager and leaver notifications. Not pay changes, which still need HRBP approval. Training records go into [[learnmoor]] as a course ([[yetunde-balogun]] set it up).

## Working Context

The first plan was e-learning only: a 25-minute Learnmoor module. After the first month only 46 managers had done it and the error rate in their requests was high (wrong absence type, part days entered as full days). Since August the standard is a 60-minute live session, in person at the hubs and online for Head Office, with the e-learning as a refresher. My view is in [[team-leaders-need-floor-training-not-e-learning]].

The [[manager-self-service-quick-guide]] (two pages, laminated at the hubs) is the most used thing we produced. Deskwell tickets about "how do I approve" dropped from 58 in July to 19 in September.

## Next Actions

- [ ] Get to 350 trained before peak starts on 2026-11-23.
- [ ] Book the hub sessions for December and January with the four hub managers.
- [ ] Add the absence type error rate per division to the October tracker.
